svg.aria-label: How an episode runs: the seed 7 base world and one of 33 tasks make a fresh episode copy behind the tool API (20 read, 8 write, 3 destructive tools). The agent, which is the oracle, a scripted baseline or a Claude model, makes tool calls and submits a decision. The scorer compares it with the hidden ground truth on decision, root cause, end state and restraint, and writes scores.jsonl, summary.json and a trace per episode to results/.
